title: Fruitbae Salt E-Liquid – Pineapple Guava 30ml
description:
Description
Freshly sliced tart pineapple pieces infused with exotic guava nectar with a touch of ice for a taste of paradise!
Sorbae Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Sorbae Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Sorbae is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
